newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA DROP PIENAAR AND STRANSKY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA DROP PIENAAR AND STRANSKY.

text.p: South Africa's victorious World Cup captain Francois Pienaar and his match-winning fly-half Joel Stransky have been omitted from the 36-strong Springbok squad to tour Argentina, France and Wales in November and December.
Pienaar last captained South Africa in their Tri-Nations defeat against New Zealand in Cape Town on August 10 when he had to come off with a neck injury.
Natal number eight Gary Teichmann, who took over for the three-test series against the All Blacks which followed, retains the captaincy for the tour.
Stransky, who kicked the drop goal which secured the Springboks a 15-12 win over the All Blacks in the World Cup final in June last year, has also been left out.
He has struggled to find form this season and was even dropped by Western Province for the final stages of the 1996 domestic Currie Cup competition.
Springbok coach Andre Markgraaff said: "On merit, Francois can't make the Springbok test side. It was a unanimous decision by the management and by me as coach of the side.

"Francois does not form part of the vision and future of South African rugby while Wayne Fyvie is the upcoming guy. We were very happy with the performance of our loose trio in our last three tests against New Zealand."

Pienaar, who first heard of his omission from television, said: "Obviously I'm disappointed. It's been a wonderful three years and a wonderful experience being right at the top where only two other captains have been.
"I'm now at the bottom but I'll be back again...I will work hard. I will ask people what is wrong with my game and put it right."
Team:

Scrum-halves: Joost van der Westhuizen, Kevin Putt, Joggie Viljoen.

Locks: Mark Andrews, Kobus Wiese, Hannes Strydom, Krynauw Otto.
Hookers: James Dalton, Henry Tromp, Chris Roussouw.
Props: Marius Hurter, Garry Pagel, Dawie Theron, Toks van der Linde, Os du Randt.
